title: Sell digital albums
description: Enable paid downloads for an album and how checkout works for fans.

blocks.content: You can offer a published album for paid download. Fans pay through YooKassa; after a successful payment they receive access to download the album.

blocks.subtitle: Requirements
content: YooKassa must be connected under **Dashboard → Payment Settings**.
The album must be published (not a draft).

blocks.subtitle: Enable sales for an album
content: Open **Dashboard → Albums** and edit the album.
In the album editor, set sales to **Sell** (or **Pre-order** if you use a future release date).
Enter the price in rubles and save your changes.
Publish the album if it is still a draft.

blocks.subtitle: What fans see
content: On your public album page, fans see the price and a purchase option.
They enter an email and name, then are redirected to YooKassa to complete payment.
After payment, they can download the album according to the access rules on the site.
